cause.failure: The local queue index restarted at zero for every native-root drain within one VM GC epoch. Enqueue deduplicated queue entries, but did not prevent repeated execution of their trace callbacks. Repeated wrapper marking therefore replayed growing queue prefixes.

changes.change: Retain the worklist cursor for the whole collection epoch, reset it with the epoch worklist, and perform ephemeron fixed-point resolution after each drained batch instead of after every native callback.
Compact expired weak-handle slots stably in linear passes, preserving dead-callback snapshots and second-pass ordering instead of erasing vector elements individually.

comparison.limitations: One process before and one process after; this is diagnostic before/after evidence, not a statistically controlled cross-build speedup estimate. The separate CDB-profiled run is excluded from benchmark statistics. Both runs precede native font-preference initialization; neither is pooled into the final Chrome comparison.

native_regressions_after_fix.details: The final native validation record retains exact observed outputs and compile/link provenance.

framework_harness: The host now measures actual View destruction separately and writes its success report afterward. The runner still requires normal process exit, covering process-global teardown.
